Content: `text(One)` factor that affects climate is amount of rainfall.
Which `bbtext(two)` statements about the amount of rainfall at Yosemite and Death Valley are true?

A.Choice: The rainfall in both parks increases in the winter.

B.Choice: The `text(yearly)` rainfall amount is greater in Yosemite.

C.Choice: Death Valley had more rain in `text(August)` than Yosemite.

D.Choice: There are more storms in Yosemite than in Death Valley.

E.Choice: Yosemite has more rainfall in the summer than in the winter.

Content: Yosemite National Park's climate is different than that of Death Valley National Park. Charise wonders how the interaction of `text(Earth's)` spheres affects the climate of `text(each park)`. Charise wants to investigate to compare how much moisture the plants in `text(each area)` contribute to the amount of moisture in the air.
Charise follows these steps to complete here investigation.

:ibox:`bbtext(Step 1)`: Divide a `10text(-gallon)` fish tank with a dark cardboard.
`bbtext(Step 2)`: Place several plants on the left side of the tank to model the biosphere in Yosemite National Park.
`bbtext(Step 3)`: Place `text(two)` cacti on the right side of the tank to model the biosphere in Death Valley National Park.
`bbtext(Step 4)`: Close the tank, and place a heat lamp above the tank.
What do the results of Charise's investigation show?

A.Choice: There is more water in the atmosphere when there is a decrease in the plants in the biosphere.

B.Choice: There is more water in the biosphere when there is a decrease in the plants in the biosphere.

C.Choice: There is more water in the geosphere when there is an increase in plants in the biosphere.

D.Choice: There is more water in the atmosphere when there is an increase in plants in the biosphere.

Content: What would happen to the amount of water in the atmosphere if Charise reduces the number of plants on the Yosemite side of the tank?

A.Choice: The amount of water will increase on the Yosemite side of the tank and decrease on the Death Valley side.

B.Choice: The amount of water will decrease on the Yosemite side of the tank and increase on the Death Valley side.

C.Choice: The amount of water will decrease on the Yosemite side of the tank and stay the same on the Death Valley side.

D.Choice: The amount of water will stay the same on the Yosemite side of the tank and decrease on the Death Valley side.

Content: Charise wonders whether the results of her investigation would have been different had she used different types of plants.
What question should Charise investigate next?

A.Choice: Will the amount of water that evaporates from `text(each plant)` depend on the type of plant?

B.Choice: How will the amount of water that evaporates from the plants change if the amount of heat is increased?

C.Choice: What will happen to the amount of water that evaporates if there are no plants in the tank?

D.Choice: Which of the spheres investigated contributes the most to the amount of water in the atmosphere?
